title: Small Lives
summary: Life goes on in the starter towns — odd jobs, mob culls, family — while crates with no maker's mark pass through and letters arrive already opened.

title: The War Comes Home
summary: War breaks between Embervale and Norhollow; refugees flood Millcross, and the first proof surfaces that the incident was staged.

title: The Ledger Game
summary: Espionage into Gildmark — stolen ledgers, double agents, and the town leaders forced out into the open.

title: The Truth Arrives Late
summary: The false flag comes out, and it changes nothing the mobs have already decided; the Bell-Keeper breaks, and the war's darkest hour is entirely human-made.

title: The Undertow
summary: The Broker falls and the relic sale is stopped at the brink — but the war doesn't end, because the hatred now belongs to the people.
